parameters.query:
select
  w.id         as will_id,
  l.full_name  as full_name,
  l.email      as email
from wills w
join leads l on l.id = w.lead_id
where w.status = 'pending_client_approval'
  and w.approval_notified_at is null
order by w.lawyer_approved_at
limit 50;

nodes.name: Select pending approvals
nodes.notes: SELECT returns one item per will owed this email (n8n reliably emits SELECT rows as items — an UPDATE...RETURNING does not). 0 rows -> run ends, no email. Keep 'Always Output Data' OFF (Settings tab).

nodes.name: Send approval-request email
nodes.notes: Static demo link (https://instawill-prypco.vercel.app) — swap for a real per-will/signed link before going live. Swap the SMTP node for Resend/SendGrid if you prefer.

parameters.query: update wills set approval_notified_at = now() where id = '{{ $('Select pending approvals').item.json.will_id }}' and approval_notified_at is null;

nodes.name: Mark notified
nodes.notes: Runs only after the email sends (send-then-mark), so an SMTP failure leaves the row un-notified and it retries next minute.
